sources.note: War 'between 1445 and 1450'; Pachacuti at Hatuncolla; Colla Kingdom ended; Lupaca submitted after the Inca invasion.

notes: Wikipedia's article is 'Lupaca'. Drawn 1150 to 1463 (conquest c. 1463), but the infobox keeps the Lupaca polity to c. 1600 (Chucuito, 20,080 households in a 16th-century census, about 100,000 people; Garci Diez de San Miguel visited in 1567; Hernando Pizarro defeated the Lupaca at the south tip of Lake Titicaca in 1538 when the Lupaca and Colla went to war). The Colla kingdom (Hatuncolla), the Pacajes, Carangas, Charcas and Quillacas have no page that gives dates; the Aymara people page names the Hatuncollas and Chuquitos and says the Inca conquest of the Altiplano 'began later than 1438 and was well completed by 1500'. The Colla have their own dossier (colla-kingdom) and the Pacajes, Carangas, Charcas and Quillacas are in aymara-kingdoms, both written from other pages (the first try at Colla_(Inca) did not load). The Colla-Inca war page says the Lupaca submitted after the Inca invasion of 1445-1450, which is earlier than the infobox c. 1463 (and the Aymara people page, which says the conquest began after 1438); the infobox date is kept because the war page gives no Lupaca year of its own.
